entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'm calling about a helmet I bought a little while ago. I'd like to return it.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about... two months ago. Let me just check our policy here.
Right, it's been a bit. I hope that's not an issue.
Oh, no problem at all! Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, and you are well within that window. We can absolutely get this processed for you.
Oh, fantastic! That's great to hear.

Of course. I'm generating your prepaid return label right now. I'll email it to the address on file. You should see it in your inbox in the next five minutes. And since you're one of our VIP members, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase, just to thank you for your loyalty.
Wow, thank you so much, Karen. I really appreciate that. You've made this very easy.
It's my pleasure! Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
